meta.judul_kerja: Ramayana inti: Rama terbuang, Sinta diculik, perang Alengka
meta.judul: Kisah Rama dan Sinta: Dibuang, Diculik, Direbut Kembali
judul_varian: Kisah Rama dan Sinta: Dibuang, Diculik, Direbut Kembali
Kenapa Rama Mau Dibuang 14 Tahun? Inti Kisah Ramayana
Ramayana: Pengasingan Rama sampai Rahwana Gugur
meta.pilar: Sejarah kelam & kisah kuno (mitologi sebagai catatan kepercayaan)
peta_3_poin: Bagaimana Sinta direbut kembali lewat perang.

walmiki_sd.catatan: Teks Walmiki (edisi vulgata, penomoran sarga bisa berbeda dari edisi kritis Baroda). Halaman yang berhasil dibuka: Ayodhya 19, 30, 112; Aranya 74; Sundara 1; Yuddha 59, 111, 116. Banyak halaman lain gagal dibuka (client_error).

walmiki_wl.atribusi: Ramayana of Valmiki, Ayodhyakanda sarga 9 (terjemahan H. P. Shastri, 1952), WisdomLib
walmiki_wl.catatan: Terjemahan modern berhak cipta; hanya dipakai untuk memeriksa isi sarga, bukan disalin.

britannica.catatan: Ringkasan alur; Uttarakanda dianggap sebagian sarjana sebagai tambahan; digubah paling cepat sekitar 300 SM.

wikipedia_ramayana.atribusi: Wikipedia, Ramayana (merujuk Goldman 1984; Goldman dan Sutherland Goldman 2022)
wikipedia_ramayana.catatan: Pendataan: buku 2-6 tertua, Bala dan Uttara kanda umumnya dianggap tambahan; naskah Bengal abad ke-6 tanpa dua kanda itu.

worldhistory.catatan: Ringkasan alur dan penanggalan (abad ke-5 SM menurut artikel ini; berbeda dengan Britannica).

ucsd_jordan.atribusi: David K. Jordan, ringkasan Ramayana, UC San Diego
ucsd_jordan.catatan: Ringkasan alur umum, tanpa nomor kanda.

hindutone.atribusi: Hindutone, ringkasan per kanda (nomor sarga memakai edisi IIT Kanpur)
hindutone.catatan: Blog populer, kredibilitas akademik rendah; hanya dipakai untuk petunjuk nomor sarga. Nomor perlu dicek ke teks. Ada selisih penomoran dengan sanskritdocuments (mis. ujian api).

brin_prambanan.atribusi: Berkala Arkeologi (BRIN), artikel relief Rahwana di Candi Prambanan (mengutip Sugijanti 1983)
brin_prambanan.catatan: Jurnal arkeologi: relief Candi Siwa dan Candi Brahma abad ke-9; ujian api (agnipariksa) tidak dimuat dalam Kakawin Ramayana.

wiki_kakawin.atribusi: Wikipedia, Kakawin Ramayana (merujuk Robson dan lainnya)
wiki_kakawin.catatan: Ditulis di Jawa Tengah akhir abad ke-9 atau awal ke-10 (Robson: antara 856 dan sekitar 930); paruh pertama mengikuti Bhattikavya, paruh kedua jauh berbeda; berakhir dengan penobatan Rama.

oapen_acri.atribusi: Acri (ed.), From Lanka Eastwards: The Ramayana in the Literature and Visual Arts of Indonesia (KITLV, 2010)
oapen_acri.catatan: Hanya 100 ribu karakter pertama dari 500 ribu yang terbaca; dipakai untuk hubungan Kakawin dengan Bhattikavya.

bates_wayang.atribusi: Joko Susilo, katalog wayang kulit koleksi Eisler, Bates College
bates_wayang.catatan: Versi wayang Jawa: Subali dan Sugriwa (air merah dan putih), Kumbakarna, Wibisana, Anoman. Hanya 100 ribu karakter pertama yang terbaca.

uad_bahastra.catatan: Rama Tambak, Sinta obong, Anoman obong dalam tradisi Jawa; penulis menyebut relief Lara Jonggrang dan kakawin tahun 903, yang tidak sama dengan sumber lain.

wiki_ramakien.catatan: Versi Thai: ujian api, Hanoman lebih besar perannya, versi standar era Rama I.

thailand_foundation.atribusi: Thailand Foundation, Ramakien: Thailand's National Epic
thailand_foundation.catatan: Versi Rama I (116 jilid), ujian api, Hanoman.

wiki_vali.catatan: Kisah Subali, Sugriwa, gua Mayavi, Rama memanah dari persembunyian.

wiki_jatayu.catatan: Jatayu melawan Rahwana; Rama menyelenggarakan upacara.

wiki_kumbhakarna.catatan: Anugerah tidur, nasihatnya kepada Rahwana, gugur.

wiki_indrajit.catatan: Nagapasa, Brahmastra, ritual Nikumbhila, gugur di tangan Laksmana.

lakshmana_rekha.catatan: Garis pelindung tidak ada pada Walmiki; baru muncul pada versi belakangan.

griffith.atribusi: Ralph T. H. Griffith, The Ramayan of Valmiki, 1870-74, Gutenberg 60188 (jilid 3, Yuddhakanda)
griffith.catatan: Domain publik. TIDAK terbuka lewat alat (robots.txt tidak terbaca). Tidak dipakai untuk kutipan.

scenes.vo: Bayangin kamu hampir diangkat jadi raja. Tiba-tiba kamu disuruh pergi ke hutan, empat belas tahun. Pangeran Rama menyanggupi. Ia cuma heran, kenapa ayahnya tidak bicara sendiri.
scenes.flow_subject: Grand royal throne hall of Ayodhya at dawn. RAMA (here in royal saffron silk with a gold circlet, no bow) stands calmly in the centre with folded hands, an empty golden coronation throne with garlands beside him, and in the shadowed background old DASARATA sits slumped on a couch, unable to look at his son.
scenes.cam_en: Slow dolly-in toward Rama
scenes.beat1: marigold garlands sway gently and light grows through the arches
scenes.beat2: Rama lowers his folded hands and looks toward his father with calm surprise
scenes.beat3: he holds a serene steady gaze while dust motes drift

scenes.vo: Hari ini kita jawab tiga hal. Kenapa Rama menerima pengasingan itu? Bagaimana istrinya, Sinta, bisa diculik? Dan bagaimana ia direbut kembali lewat perang besar?
scenes.flow_subject: Epic three-part composition in one frame: left, SINTA sitting by a forest cottage in morning light; centre, RAMA standing on a rock looking forward with his bow; right, the dark silhouette of RAHWANA above a red-lit island fortress across a stormy sea.
scenes.cam_en: Slow pull-back revealing all three
scenes.beat1: morning light moves across the forest side
scenes.beat2: sea waves roll and clouds drift over the fortress
scenes.beat3: Rama holds his gaze as the wind moves his sash

scenes.vo: Menurut Walmiki, penyair kisah ini, semuanya bermula dari bisikan. Mantara, pelayan Ratu Kaikeyi, menghasut majikannya: kalau Rama jadi raja, putramu Bharata akan tersingkir.
scenes.flow_subject: A lamp-lit palace chamber at night. An old hunch-backed maid with grey hair and a brown sari whispers into the ear of KAIKEYI, whose face shows growing worry; through a carved window the city of Ayodhya is decorated with festival lamps.
scenes.cam_en: Slow push-in on the two faces
scenes.beat1: the oil lamp flickers and the maid leans closer
scenes.beat2: Kaikeyi's eyes narrow and she turns slightly away from the festive window
scenes.beat3: she clenches the edge of her sari and stays still

scenes.vo: Dulu Raja Dasarata pernah menjanjikan dua permintaan kepada Kaikeyi. Malam itu ia menagihnya: Bharata harus jadi raja, dan Rama harus diasingkan ke hutan empat belas tahun.
scenes.flow_subject: Dim royal chamber of sorrow. KAIKEYI sits upright on the floor, ornaments scattered around her, holding up two fingers firmly, while DASARATA kneels facing her in shock, one hand on his chest, a single lamp between them.
scenes.cam_en: Slow arc from Kaikeyi toward Dasarata
scenes.beat1: the lamp flame bends as Kaikeyi raises two fingers
scenes.beat2: Dasarata's shoulders sink and his eyes fill with grief
scenes.beat3: he lowers his head while she remains unmoved

scenes.vo: Rama tidak melawan. Baginya, janji seorang ayah harus ditepati, dan membantu menepatinya adalah dharma, kewajiban luhur seorang anak. Takhta boleh lepas. Kehormatan kata-kata jangan.
scenes.flow_subject: RAMA (royal saffron silk, gold circlet) bows respectfully with folded hands before KAIKEYI in a quiet palace corridor; he gently places his gold crown ornament on a silk cushion held by an attendant, warm light from behind him.
scenes.cam_en: Slow push-in on Rama's hands and face
scenes.beat1: Rama lifts the circlet from his head
scenes.beat2: he sets it gently on the silk cushion
scenes.beat3: he folds his hands with a peaceful smile

scenes.vo: Sinta menolak tinggal di istana yang nyaman. Menurutnya, tempat seorang istri ada di sisi suaminya, di mana pun. Rama sempat melarang, tetapi akhirnya luluh.
scenes.flow_subject: A palace garden terrace at sunset. SINTA holds RAMA's hands firmly with a determined, loving expression; Rama looks at her tenderly; behind them lotus ponds, marble pillars and peacocks.
scenes.cam_en: Slow orbit around the couple
scenes.beat1: the lotus pond ripples and a peacock turns
scenes.beat2: Sinta gently pulls his hands closer and nods
scenes.beat3: Rama's face softens and he smiles

scenes.vo: Laksmana, adik Rama, juga ikut. Rama meninggalkan busana kerajaan dan mengenakan pakaian pertapa. Rakyat Ayodhya menangis mengantar kereta mereka sampai ke gerbang kota.
scenes.flow_subject: A chariot with two white horses leaves the great gate of Ayodhya at golden hour carrying RAMA, SINTA and LAKSMANA; a large crowd of townspeople reaches out sadly, flower petals falling, towering sandstone gate with carvings.
scenes.cam_en: Slow tracking move following the chariot
scenes.beat1: the horses step forward and petals fall
scenes.beat2: townspeople raise their hands in farewell
scenes.beat3: the chariot moves under the gate as dust glows

scenes.vo: Kepergian itu terlalu berat bagi Dasarata. Tak lama kemudian, sang raja wafat karena duka. Bharata pulang dan terkejut: mahkota menunggunya, dengan harga yang tidak ia minta.
scenes.flow_subject: A silent royal bedchamber at blue dawn: a covered royal bed with the gold crown resting on it, a young prince in white and gold (Bharata) standing at the doorway with a hand on the frame, devastated, lamps burning low, white curtains moving.
scenes.cam_en: Slow push-in from the doorway to the crown
scenes.beat1: curtains drift in the cold breeze
scenes.beat2: Bharata steps one pace forward
scenes.beat3: he stops and looks down at the crown without touching it

scenes.vo: Bharata menyusul Rama ke hutan dan memohonnya pulang. Rama menolak, karena janji belum selesai. Bharata lalu meminta satu hal saja: sandal kakaknya.
scenes.flow_subject: In a green forest clearing on Chitrakuta hill beside a leaf hut, Bharata, a young prince in simple white, kneels and receives a pair of golden-wood sandals from RAMA with both hands; royal elephants and soldiers wait far behind among the trees.
scenes.cam_en: Slow dolly-in on the sandals
scenes.beat1: sunbeams shift through the leaves
scenes.beat2: Rama places the sandals into Bharata's hands
scenes.beat3: Bharata raises them to his forehead and closes his eyes

scenes.vo: Sandal itu ia letakkan di singgasana. Bharata sendiri memerintah dari Nandigrama, desa di luar ibu kota, hidup sederhana, dan menunggu kakaknya pulang selama empat belas tahun.
scenes.flow_subject: A humble village hall at Nandigrama: a pair of golden-wood sandals rest on a small throne under a white royal umbrella, Bharata, a young man with plain ascetic clothes and matted hair, sits on the floor beside it reading petitions with villagers, warm lamp light.
scenes.cam_en: Slow push-in on the sandals under the umbrella
scenes.beat1: the tassels of the umbrella sway
scenes.beat2: Bharata bows toward the sandals
scenes.beat3: lamp light glows steadily on the sandals

scenes.vo: Rama, Sinta, dan Laksmana masuk makin dalam, ke rimba Dandaka. Sekitar sepuluh tahun mereka berpindah dari satu pertapaan ke pertapaan lain, melindungi para pertapa.
scenes.flow_subject: RAMA, SINTA and LAKSMANA walk in single file along a path through a vast misty ancient forest with giant roots, waterfalls and shafts of light; in the distance a small hermitage with sages waving.
scenes.cam_en: Slow lateral tracking beside the walkers
scenes.beat1: mist rolls between huge trunks
scenes.beat2: the three walk forward steadily
scenes.beat3: Rama pauses and greets the distant sages

scenes.vo: Akhirnya mereka membangun pondok di Panchawati, di tepi Sungai Godawari. Tempatnya indah dan tenang. Tak seorang pun menyangka, di sinilah badai dimulai.
scenes.flow_subject: A charming thatched leaf cottage by a wide river with lotus flowers at golden sunrise; LAKSMANA ties bamboo on the roof, SINTA waters flowering plants, RAMA sits sharpening an arrow, deer in the background.
scenes.cam_en: Slow crane down from the river to the cottage
scenes.beat1: the river sparkles and birds fly
scenes.beat2: Sinta pours water and Laksmana ties the bamboo
scenes.beat3: Rama looks up as a shadow of cloud passes

scenes.vo: Datanglah Surpanakha, adik Rahwana, raja negeri Alengka. Ia jatuh hati pada Rama. Ditolak, ia menyerang Sinta, lalu Laksmana melukai wajahnya atas perintah Rama.
scenes.flow_subject: Tense moment outside the cottage: a tall wild demoness with ash-brown skin, fiery eyes, dark red garments and long claws lunges toward SINTA; RAMA shields Sinta with his arm while LAKSMANA steps between with his sword raised, no blood.
scenes.cam_en: Quick but smooth push-in
scenes.beat1: the demoness raises her claws and leaves swirl
scenes.beat2: Laksmana steps forward with sword raised and Rama pulls Sinta back
scenes.beat3: the demoness recoils, covering her face with her sleeve

scenes.vo: Surpanakha mencari balasan. Pasukan saudaranya dikalahkan Rama. Maka ia menghadap Rahwana di Alengka, dan menyebut satu hal yang memancing: kecantikan Sinta.
scenes.flow_subject: Magnificent dark golden throne hall of Alengka with red braziers; RAHWANA sits on a huge throne leaning forward with interest, while the wild demoness in red kneels covering part of her face with her veil and gestures as if describing a vision of a beautiful woman in glowing smoke.
scenes.cam_en: Slow push-in toward Rahwana's face
scenes.beat1: braziers flare and smoke curls into a woman's soft silhouette
scenes.beat2: Rahwana leans forward, eyes fixed on the smoke
scenes.beat3: a slow proud smile appears on his face

scenes.vo: Rahwana tidak mau berhadapan langsung. Ia mendatangi Marica, raksasa yang pandai berubah rupa. Marica sudah memperingatkan: jangan ganggu Rama. Tetapi Rahwana mengancam.
scenes.flow_subject: A rocky seaside hermitage at dusk: a thin elderly shape-shifter demon with grey skin and simple dark robe raises both palms in warning, while RAHWANA towers over him pointing, his flying chariot resting behind.
scenes.cam_en: Slow low-angle push-in
scenes.beat1: waves crash and the old demon shakes his head
scenes.beat2: Rahwana points sternly and his cloak billows
scenes.beat3: the old demon lowers his hands in defeat

scenes.vo: Marica terpaksa setuju. Ia menjelma menjadi kijang emas berbintik perak, lalu berkeliaran di depan pondok. Sinta terpikat dan meminta Rama menangkapnya.
scenes.flow_subject: A dazzling golden deer with silver spots and jewel-like antlers stands in a sunlit flower meadow near the cottage; SINTA in the foreground holds flowers and looks at it with wonder.
scenes.cam_en: Slow push-in from Sinta toward the deer
scenes.beat1: the deer lifts its head and its coat shimmers
scenes.beat2: Sinta steps forward and points with delight
scenes.beat3: the deer turns and takes a few graceful steps away

scenes.vo: Laksmana curiga itu tipuan. Rama tahu risikonya, tetapi tetap mengejar. Ia berpesan tegas kepada adiknya: jaga Sinta baik-baik, jangan sampai lengah.
scenes.flow_subject: Beside the cottage LAKSMANA whispers a warning to RAMA while pointing to the distant golden deer; Rama holds his bow and places a firm hand on Laksmana's shoulder; SINTA watches from the doorway.
scenes.cam_en: Slow push-in on the two brothers
scenes.beat1: Laksmana points toward the glittering deer
scenes.beat2: Rama places his hand on his brother's shoulder
scenes.beat3: Rama turns and takes his first step toward the forest

scenes.vo: Jauh di dalam hutan, panah Rama mengenai kijang itu. Sebelum tumbang, Marica kembali ke wujud asli dan menjerit meniru suara Rama: tolong aku, Laksmana!
scenes.flow_subject: Deep dark forest: RAMA stands with his bow lowered after shooting; ahead the golden deer dissolves into golden light revealing the old grey shape-shifter demon falling to his knees with an open mouth crying out, no blood.
scenes.cam_en: Slow dolly from behind Rama
scenes.beat1: golden particles swirl around the deer
scenes.beat2: the old demon appears in the light and cries out
scenes.beat3: Rama turns his head back sharply in alarm

scenes.vo: Sinta panik dan mendesak Laksmana menolong. Laksmana menolak, sampai Sinta menuduhnya dengan kata-kata tajam. Dengan berat hati, ia pun pergi meninggalkan pondok.
scenes.flow_subject: At the cottage door SINTA, frightened and tearful, points urgently toward the dark forest; LAKSMANA, hurt and reluctant, grips his bow and looks back at her.
scenes.cam_en: Slow push-in between the two faces
scenes.beat1: Sinta points to the forest with trembling hand
scenes.beat2: Laksmana shakes his head, then his face fills with pain
scenes.beat3: he turns and walks away looking back once

scenes.vo: Satu catatan penting. Banyak orang mengenal garis pelindung yang digambar Laksmana. Dalam kitab Walmiki, garis itu tidak ada. Ia muncul di versi yang jauh lebih muda.
scenes.flow_subject: Close view of the cottage yard at twilight: a faint glowing golden line curves across the earth in front of the doorway like a legend, an old palm-leaf manuscript with abstract unreadable marks lies on a wooden stool in the foreground, oil lamp.
scenes.cam_en: Slow tilt from the manuscript up to the glowing line
scenes.beat1: the lamp flickers over the manuscript
scenes.beat2: the golden line shimmers softly
scenes.beat3: the line slowly fades into plain earth

scenes.vo: Saat Sinta sendirian, datang seorang pertapa tua meminta sedekah. Sinta menyambutnya dengan sopan. Tiba-tiba, sang tamu menampakkan wujud aslinya: Rahwana.
scenes.flow_subject: At the cottage doorway SINTA offers a bowl of fruit to an old hooded ascetic with a staff; behind the ascetic his giant shadow on the wall and swirling red mist reveal the shape of RAHWANA with many crowned heads.
scenes.cam_en: Slow push-in with the shadow growing
scenes.beat1: Sinta offers the bowl politely
scenes.beat2: the shadow behind the ascetic grows many heads
scenes.beat3: red mist swirls as Sinta steps back

scenes.vo: Rahwana membawa Sinta terbang. Dari udara, Sinta membungkus beberapa perhiasannya dengan kain, lalu menjatuhkannya ke sebuah bukit tempat para kera duduk.
scenes.flow_subject: A majestic golden flying chariot high above clouds and forest hills; SINTA leans over the side dropping a small cloth bundle of gold ornaments, RAHWANA drives with cloak billowing; far below on a rocky hill five small monkeys look up.
scenes.cam_en: Slow tracking alongside the chariot
scenes.beat1: clouds rush past and her veil streams
scenes.beat2: Sinta lets go of the cloth bundle
scenes.beat3: the bundle falls glinting toward the hill

scenes.vo: Di langit, Jatayu, burung tua sahabat Dasarata, melihat semuanya. Ia sudah renta, tetapi tetap menghadang. Ia melawan sekuat tenaga, sampai akhirnya jatuh terluka.
scenes.flow_subject: Dramatic sky battle: huge JATAYU with spread silver-brown wings swoops in front of the golden flying chariot; RAHWANA raises his sword; SINTA reaches out toward the bird; sunset clouds, no blood.
scenes.cam_en: Slow dynamic orbit
scenes.beat1: Jatayu beats his great wings and blocks the chariot
scenes.beat2: Rahwana swings his sword in a wide arc
scenes.beat3: Jatayu glides downward with loose feathers drifting

scenes.vo: Rama pulang dan mendapati pondok kosong. Dalam pencarian, ia menemukan Jatayu yang sekarat. Setelah memberi kabar, burung setia itu wafat, dan Rama sendiri memakamkannya.
scenes.flow_subject: Forest hillside at dusk: RAMA kneels gently cradling the head of the great fallen JATAYU on a bed of leaves, feathers around, LAKSMANA stands behind with bowed head, warm last light.
scenes.cam_en: Slow push-in on Rama and the bird's eye
scenes.beat1: Jatayu slowly opens his eye and Rama leans close
scenes.beat2: the bird rests his head in Rama's hands and closes his eyes
scenes.beat3: Rama bows his head while feathers drift

scenes.vo: Perjalanan berlanjut. Mereka bertemu Kabandha, makhluk raksasa tanpa kepala. Setelah dibebaskan Rama, ia memberi petunjuk penting: carilah Sugriwa, raja kera yang terbuang.
scenes.flow_subject: A giant headless forest creature with a single glowing eye on its chest and very long arms transforms into a radiant celestial being rising from golden fire, pointing toward distant mountains; RAMA and LAKSMANA watch below.
scenes.cam_en: Slow tilt up with the rising light
scenes.beat1: golden fire swirls around the creature
scenes.beat2: a shining celestial figure rises from the glow
scenes.beat3: he points toward the far mountain

scenes.vo: Mereka juga singgah di pertapaan Sabari, perempuan tua yang saleh. Dengan tulus ia menyambut Rama dengan buah hutan. Lalu keduanya berjalan menuju gunung tempat Sugriwa.
scenes.flow_subject: A tiny flower-covered hermitage by a lotus lake: an elderly saintly woman with white hair and bark-cloth sari, SABARI, offers forest berries on a leaf plate to RAMA, who accepts with a warm smile, LAKSMANA beside him.
scenes.cam_en: Slow push-in on the leaf plate and faces
scenes.beat1: petals drift over the lake
scenes.beat2: Sabari raises the leaf plate with shaking hands
scenes.beat3: Rama takes a berry and smiles warmly

scenes.vo: Di bukit, Sugriwa melihat dua orang bersenjata dan mengutus Hanoman memeriksa. Hanoman, kera yang cerdas dan santun, menyapa mereka, lalu langsung percaya pada Rama.
scenes.flow_subject: On a rocky mountain path with a deep valley behind, HANOMAN bows on one knee with folded hands before RAMA and LAKSMANA, golden sunlight, Rama extending a hand to lift him.
scenes.cam_en: Slow orbit around Hanoman and Rama
scenes.beat1: Hanoman lands softly and kneels
scenes.beat2: he folds his hands and speaks with respect
scenes.beat3: Rama reaches out and helps him stand

scenes.vo: Rama dan Sugriwa bersahabat dengan sumpah di depan api. Sugriwa lalu menunjukkan bungkusan perhiasan yang jatuh dari langit. Rama mengenalinya, dan air matanya menetes.
scenes.flow_subject: Night camp in a mountain cave mouth with a sacred fire: RAMA holds an opened cloth with gold ornaments, eyes wet with tears, SUGRIWA sits facing him with a hand on his heart, HANOMAN tends the fire.
scenes.cam_en: Slow push-in on the ornaments in Rama's hands
scenes.beat1: fire sparks rise as Sugriwa places his hand on his heart
scenes.beat2: Rama unfolds the cloth revealing the ornaments
scenes.beat3: Rama holds an earring close and closes his eyes

scenes.vo: Sugriwa juga punya luka. Ia pernah dikira merebut takhta, lalu diusir kakaknya, Subali, dan istrinya direbut. Rama berjanji membantunya menghadapi sang kakak.
scenes.flow_subject: At the gate of a monkey kingdom carved into red cliffs, powerful SUBALI points sternly outward from a high step with a crown, while SUGRIWA walks away downhill looking back sadly.
scenes.cam_en: Slow pull-back from the cliff gate
scenes.beat1: Subali raises his arm and points away
scenes.beat2: Sugriwa walks down the steps
scenes.beat3: he pauses and looks back with sorrow

scenes.vo: Saat dua bersaudara itu berduel, Rama memanah Subali dari balik pohon. Subali menegurnya. Rama menjawab dengan hukum bagi raja. Sampai kini, pembaca masih memperdebatkannya.
scenes.flow_subject: Forest arena: in the mid-ground SUBALI and SUGRIWA wrestle, in the foreground RAMA half hidden behind a huge tree draws his bow with a serious conflicted expression, no arrow impact, no blood.
scenes.cam_en: Slow rack focus from Rama to the duel
scenes.beat1: the two monkey kings grapple and dust rises
scenes.beat2: Rama draws the bowstring slowly
scenes.beat3: he holds the aim, face troubled and still

scenes.vo: Pasukan kera disebar ke empat arah. Kepada Hanoman, yang menuju selatan, Rama menitipkan cincinnya. Itu tanda, supaya Sinta tahu utusan ini benar-benar dari suaminya.
scenes.flow_subject: Morning on a mountain ledge with thousands of monkey soldiers setting off in the valley: RAMA places a gold ring into HANOMAN's open palm, both looking at it solemnly.
scenes.cam_en: Slow macro push-in on the ring
scenes.beat1: the army moves in the valley far below
scenes.beat2: Rama lays the ring into Hanoman's palm
scenes.beat3: Hanoman closes his fist over it against his chest

scenes.vo: Di pantai selatan, mereka buntu di depan lautan. Burung tua Sampati memberi tahu: Sinta ada di Alengka. Lalu tetua kera, Jambawan, mengingatkan Hanoman siapa dirinya.
scenes.flow_subject: Wide dramatic seashore with enormous ocean: an old wise bear-like elder with grey fur places a paw on the shoulder of HANOMAN, who looks across the sea; on a cliff above an old vulture with burnt wings looks toward a faint island on the horizon.
scenes.cam_en: Slow push-in toward Hanoman looking at the sea
scenes.beat1: waves roll and the old vulture lifts his head
scenes.beat2: the bear elder speaks with his paw on Hanoman's shoulder
scenes.beat3: Hanoman lifts his chin and his eyes brighten

scenes.vo: Hanoman membesarkan tubuhnya dan melompat melintasi lautan. Rintangan datang silih berganti. Dengan mengubah ukuran tubuh dan memakai akal, ia lolos, lalu tiba di Alengka.
scenes.flow_subject: Colossal HANOMAN leaping high over a turquoise stormy ocean with the mountain behind him cracking, a huge sea serpent rising from the waves below, a golden island city glowing far ahead, tail streaming.
scenes.cam_en: Epic slow tracking with Hanoman in flight
scenes.beat1: Hanoman soars forward with wind rippling his fur
scenes.beat2: the sea serpent rises below and he twists past
scenes.beat3: the golden island grows larger ahead

scenes.vo: Hanoman menemukan Sinta di taman asoka, sedih dan dijaga para raksasi. Diam-diam ia menyerahkan cincin Rama. Untuk pertama kalinya, Sinta kembali punya harapan.
scenes.flow_subject: Moonlit ashoka garden full of orange blossoms: SINTA sits on the ground in a simple faded pink sari, a small HANOMAN on a low branch gently offers the gold ring; sleeping guard demonesses in the dim background.
scenes.cam_en: Slow push-in on the ring and Sinta's face
scenes.beat1: blossoms fall in moonlight
scenes.beat2: Hanoman reaches down with the ring
scenes.beat3: Sinta takes it and her eyes fill with hope

scenes.vo: Hanoman menawarkan menggendongnya pulang. Sinta menolak. Ia tak ingin menyentuh lelaki lain, dan ia ingin Rama sendiri yang datang menjemput dengan terhormat.
scenes.flow_subject: In the ashoka garden SINTA stands upright and dignified, gently raising her palm to decline, the ring on her finger, while HANOMAN kneels before her listening respectfully, dawn light beginning.
scenes.cam_en: Slow orbit around Sinta
scenes.beat1: dawn light touches the blossoms
scenes.beat2: Sinta raises her palm gently
scenes.beat3: Hanoman bows his head with respect

scenes.vo: Hanoman sengaja membuat keributan sampai ditangkap. Ekornya dibakar. Justru dengan ekor menyala itu ia melompati atap demi atap, membakar Alengka, lalu pulang membawa kabar.
scenes.flow_subject: HANOMAN leaping between golden palace rooftops of Alengka at night with the tip of his long tail blazing like a torch, roofs catching orange fire, smoke, no people harmed visible, sea in the background.
scenes.cam_en: Slow tracking following the leap
scenes.beat1: flames dance at the tip of his tail
scenes.beat2: he springs from one roof to the next
scenes.beat3: he looks back at the glowing city against the night sea

scenes.vo: Di Alengka, Wibisana, adik Rahwana, menasihati agar Sinta dikembalikan. Rahwana malah menghinanya. Wibisana memilih pergi, dan bergabung dengan pihak Rama.
scenes.flow_subject: Throne hall council: WIBISANA stands with open palms speaking calmly while RAHWANA rises from the throne in anger pointing away; ministers look down.
scenes.cam_en: Slow push-in on Wibisana
scenes.beat1: Wibisana speaks with open hands
scenes.beat2: Rahwana stands and points sharply
scenes.beat3: Wibisana bows, turns and walks toward the light of the doorway

scenes.vo: Pasukan tiba di pantai. Dipimpin Nala, para kera membangun jembatan dari batu dan pohon. Orang Jawa mengenal kisah ini sebagai Rama Tambak, artinya Rama membendung laut.
scenes.flow_subject: Spectacular sunrise over the ocean: thousands of monkey workers carrying boulders and trunks build a long stone bridge toward the island fortress; RAMA, HANOMAN and SUGRIWA watch from a rock in the foreground.
scenes.cam_en: Slow crane rise revealing the bridge
scenes.beat1: monkeys pass boulders in a long line
scenes.beat2: splashes rise as stones are placed
scenes.beat3: the finished span glows toward the island

scenes.vo: Perang pecah. Saat Rahwana turun sendiri, Rama menghancurkan kereta dan mahkotanya. Melihat musuhnya kelelahan, Rama menyuruhnya pulang, memulihkan tenaga, baru bertarung lagi.
scenes.flow_subject: Battlefield at dusk: an exhausted RAHWANA kneels beside his broken chariot, his crown fallen on the ground; RAMA stands facing him with his bow lowered, gesturing calmly toward the city, banners and dust, no blood.
scenes.cam_en: Slow low-angle push-in
scenes.beat1: dust settles around the broken chariot
scenes.beat2: Rama lowers his bow
scenes.beat3: Rama gestures toward the city as Rahwana lifts his eyes

scenes.vo: Adik Rahwana yang lain, Kumbakarna, dibangunkan dari tidur panjang. Ia menegur kakaknya, tetapi tetap maju demi saudara dan negerinya. Ia pun gugur.
scenes.flow_subject: Giant KUMBAKARNA rises from an enormous bed in a vast cavern-like hall, small drummers and attendants around him, RAHWANA standing at the foot of the bed; warm torchlight.
scenes.cam_en: Slow tilt up the giant
scenes.beat1: drums are struck and the giant opens his eyes
scenes.beat2: he sits up and looks seriously at Rahwana
scenes.beat3: he places a hand on his armour with resolve

scenes.vo: Putra Rahwana, Indrajit, melepaskan panah ular yang mengikat Rama dan Laksmana. Burung raksasa Garuda datang membebaskan mereka. Kelak, Indrajit gugur di tangan Laksmana.
scenes.flow_subject: RAMA and LAKSMANA sit bound by glowing magical serpent coils of light on the battlefield; the golden eagle Garuda descends with huge wings as the serpents recoil; INDRAJIT watches from a cloud above.
scenes.cam_en: Slow push-in from above
scenes.beat1: serpent coils of light tighten and glow
scenes.beat2: Garuda sweeps down with radiant wings
scenes.beat3: the coils burst into sparks and the brothers rise

scenes.vo: Akhirnya Rama berhadapan dengan Rahwana. Menurut Walmiki, duel itu berlangsung berhari-hari. Setiap kepala Rahwana yang terlepas, tumbuh lagi. Senjata biasa tidak cukup.
scenes.flow_subject: Epic duel between two flying war chariots at sunset: RAMA on a celestial golden chariot drawing his bow, RAHWANA on a dark chariot with all his crowned heads glowing, arrows of light crossing, storm clouds.
scenes.cam_en: Slow circling camera between the chariots
scenes.beat1: arrows of light cross the sky
scenes.beat2: Rahwana's heads flare with red light
scenes.beat3: Rama steadies his bow and breathes

scenes.vo: Rama lalu melepaskan panah Brahma, senjata pemberian dewa pencipta. Panah itu menembus dada Rahwana. Raja Alengka gugur, dan hujan bunga turun ke kereta Rama.
scenes.flow_subject: A blazing golden arrow of light flies from RAMA's bow toward the distant silhouette of RAHWANA; flower petals begin raining from golden clouds onto Rama's chariot, no wound visible, no blood.
scenes.cam_en: Slow push following the arrow of light
scenes.beat1: Rama releases the glowing arrow
scenes.beat2: a bright burst of golden light fills the distance
scenes.beat3: flower petals shower down over Rama's chariot

scenes.vo: Mandodari, istri Rahwana, meratap. Wibisana ragu mengurus jenazah kakaknya. Rama berkata, permusuhan selesai bersama kematian. Maka upacara penghormatan pun digelar dengan layak.
scenes.flow_subject: Quiet twilight battlefield: RAMA places a hand on WIBISANA's shoulder; beyond them a grieving queen in white kneels beside a royal bier covered with a red-gold cloth and flowers, oil lamps.
scenes.cam_en: Slow push-in on the two men
scenes.beat1: lamps flicker beside the covered bier
scenes.beat2: Rama rests his hand on Wibisana's shoulder
scenes.beat3: Wibisana bows his head and nods

scenes.vo: Sinta akhirnya dibawa menghadap. Namun di depan banyak orang, Rama meragukan kesuciannya, karena ia lama tinggal di istana Rahwana. Sinta sangat terluka.
scenes.flow_subject: A wide open ground before the army: SINTA stands alone in the centre with tearful dignified face; RAMA stands apart looking away with a heavy conflicted expression; HANOMAN and soldiers look on in shock.
scenes.cam_en: Slow push-in on Sinta
scenes.beat1: wind moves her veil
scenes.beat2: Rama turns his face aside
scenes.beat3: Sinta lifts her chin through her tears

scenes.vo: Sinta meminta api dinyalakan. Ia bersumpah hatinya tidak pernah berpaling, lalu masuk ke dalamnya. Agni, dewa api, keluar membawanya utuh dan menyatakan ia suci.
scenes.flow_subject: A great golden ceremonial fire; from its heart a radiant god of fire with a flaming halo gently leads SINTA out, completely unharmed and glowing, her garlands fresh; RAMA steps forward in awe.
scenes.cam_en: Slow push-in into the golden light
scenes.beat1: flames rise in a soft golden swirl
scenes.beat2: the fire god emerges guiding Sinta forward unharmed
scenes.beat3: Rama steps toward her with relief

scenes.vo: Tidak semua versi sama. Kakawin Ramayana dari Jawa Kuno, menurut kajian arkeologi, tidak memuat ujian api itu. Sementara di Prambanan, kisah penculikan Sinta dipahat di batu.
scenes.flow_subject: Prambanan temple in Central Java at golden hour with its tall carved stone spires; in the foreground a close carved andesite relief panel showing a flying demon king carrying a woman while a great bird attacks.
scenes.cam_en: Slow pan from the relief to the temple
scenes.beat1: golden light slides across the carved stone
scenes.beat2: the focus shifts from relief to the spires
scenes.beat3: birds cross the evening sky

scenes.vo: Empat belas tahun genap. Rama, Sinta, dan Laksmana pulang. Bharata menyerahkan kembali kerajaan, dan Rama dinobatkan. Menurutmu, sudah adilkah Rama kepada Sinta? Tulis di komentar.
scenes.flow_subject: Joyful coronation night in Ayodhya: RAMA and SINTA in magnificent royal attire seated on a golden throne, LAKSMANA holding a white umbrella, HANOMAN kneeling, Bharata presenting the sandals, thousands of oil lamps and fireworks over the city.
scenes.cam_en: Slow grand pull-back over the city
scenes.beat1: thousands of lamps flicker
scenes.beat2: Bharata bows and presents the sandals
scenes.beat3: Sinta looks quietly toward the lamps with a thoughtful face
